title: Keep installed skills synchronized with repository skills
goal: Ensure harness packages and fresh project scaffolds include the current repository-local skills and all of their supporting files.
in_scope: Synchronize every skill under `.agents/skills/`, including nested references, assets, and agent metadata, into the installable scaffold as part of package creation.
Include all synchronized files in both wheel and source distributions used by `uv tool install` and `uvx`.
Update README installation documentation to describe that all repository-local skills are included.
out_of_scope: Installing skills into a user's global agent configuration outside the initialized project.
Overwriting existing skill files in a target project during `harness init`.
acceptance_criteria: Building the package synchronizes the full `.agents/skills/` tree into the packaged templates without relying on manual per-skill copies.
The built wheel and source distribution contain every source skill file with identical relative paths and contents.
A fresh project initialized from the built package has all repository-local skills and nested supporting files.
Running initialization again preserves pre-existing skill files.
verification: Compare the `.agents/skills/` tree with the contents in both built distributions.
Initialize a temporary project from the built wheel and compare its skill tree with the repository source.
